result.reasoning:
The mechanism is real but unreachable in a way that matters, and the reporter's impact numbers are mis-attributed.

(1) REACHABILITY. `dedup_key` has exactly ONE production call site: scripts/idea_search.py:221. `grep -ln Guidance scripts/*.py partura/*.py` returns only scripts/idea_search.py and partura/steer.py itself. No factor sweep, variant table, cluster or report script imports Guidance — partura/runner.py, scripts/sweep.py, scripts/sweep_final.py, scripts/batch_cluster.py, scripts/batch2_summary.py, scripts/readable_report.py never dedup. The second consumer, Guidance.accept(expr, u=None) (steer.py:315), is dead in production: the only caller is `G.accept(e, u=self._rng.random())`.

(2) THE BRANCH HAS NEVER FIRED. Both idea_search runs on disk record equivalent = 0, and the counts close exactly, so this is arithmetic rather than an absent Counter key: episodes/e1_I2_dispersion_fold/evidence.json steer arm proposed=430 = accepted 167 + outside 243 + thinned 20; episodes/smoke_I1_frozen_state/evidence.json steer arm proposed=29 = 23 + 4 + 2. equivalent=banned=unread=0 in both. Not one proposal was ever rejected as `equivalent`. Both episodes also ended passers=0 in BOTH arms, so there is no conclusion a suppressed candidate could flip. episodes/*/{steer,control}/checkpoints are empty — these two evidence.json files are the entire idea_search record.

(3) THE CORPUS EVIDENCE PROVES THE OPPOSITE OF THE CLAIM. tmp/review/matcher-guidance/rows.json is built by collect.py from runs/F1*/sweep_s3.json — the undeduped sweep population. Regrouping it: all 4 cited buckets have EVERY member scored (10/10, 10/10, 6/6, 3/3). The 1.07 and 1.03 spreads exist in the reported tables precisely because nothing was deduped. Nothing was "dropped unscored".

(4) THE SPREADS ARE MIS-ATTRIBUTED. Three of the four buckets (F108 x2, and F109 restricted) consist entirely of members with ONE distinct price leaf — pure single-position leaf swaps, exactly what C7's rho 0.96-0.98 evidence licenses; the global/multi-leaf substitution the finding is titled on contributes nothing there. The F112 bucket's 1.03 is driven solely by the member `win` = cs_winsor(...) at -0.246 against +0.789, and cs_winsor is stripped by a DIFFERENT rewrite rule, not by C7 (verified: canonical('cs_winsor(day_max(pow_2(nt_ts_kurt(Close,30))))') == 'day_max(pow_2(nt_ts_kurt(Close, 30)))'). Restricted to the members C7's substitution actually merges, that bucket spreads 0.09 — inside the ±0.3 noise band. The two members the finding names by hand, F112 v_base 0.739 and leaf_High_close 0.789, differ by 0.05. F109 restricted to ≤1 distinct leaf still spreads 0.60, so whatever is wrong there is C7's own premise, not the global substitution.

(5) THE PATHOLOGICAL INPUT DOES NOT OCCUR. On 2974 real GP archive expressions from /Users/wxy/Desktop/AlphaCube/mining_runs/*/checkpoints/archive_gen*.csv (2974/2974 parsed): 86 of 2829 dedup buckets hold >1 canonical form, and only 9 involve a member with ≥2 distinct price leaves — of which 4 differ in exactly one leaf POSITION, i.e. C7's licensed case showing up only because Close also appears elsewhere in the tree. `<op>(P1, P2)` with two different bare price leaves — the sub(High,Low) / sub(Close,Open) / div(sub(Close,Low),sub(High,Low)) family the whole failure scenario is built on — occurs in 1 of 2974 expressions, and in zero collisions. This grammar does not breed sub/div of two bare price leaves; daily range, daily return and upper shadow are simply not in the search's output distribution.

(6) ONE FACTUAL ERROR IN THE FINDING. "one experiment whose representative is identically 0" and "i.e. 0/0" are false. idea_search.py:222 is `first_form.setdefault(key, e)` — it stores `e`, the real expression string, and the GP scores `e`. The key string `div(sub(Close,Close),sub(Close,Close))` is only a dict key: never parsed, never built into a panel, never evaluated. No degenerate 0 or 0/0 panel is ever produced.

VERDICT: the collapse is too coarse as a matter of design, but its effect on this batch is exactly zero (equivalent=0 in every run that exists), its effect on the sweep corpus is zero (the corpus is never deduped), and its forward exposure on the largest real archive on disk is 5 buckets in 2829, all well inside the ±0.3 Sharpe / ±3pt band. Not a defect that changes a number or a conclusion.

result.corrected_fix:
No re-run and no number changes either way; make it only as cheap hardening of partura/steer.py:283-290, and note that one of the two suggested variants does not work.

The reporter's second alternative (positional renaming: first distinct leaf -> Close, second -> Close2) does NOT fix their own headline example: sub(High, Low) -> sub(Close, Close2) and sub(Close, Open) -> sub(Close, Close2) still collide. Do not use it.

The correct change is the first alternative only — gate the collapse on the canonical form containing at most one distinct @price leaf:

    def dedup_key(self, expr: str) -> str:
        s = self.canonical(expr)
        for r in self.rules:
            if r.action == "dedup_key" and r.pattern.tree.name in LEAF_KINDS:
                fam = LEAF_KINDS[r.pattern.tree.name]
                seen = set(re.findall(r"\b(" + "|".join(fam) + r")\b", s))
                if len(seen) > 1:      # C7's evidence is a SINGLE-leaf swap in an otherwise identical tree
                    continue           # (rho 0.96-0.98); it does not license a per-occurrence substitution
                s = re.sub(r"\b(" + "|".join(fam) + r")\b", r.to, s)
        return re.sub(r"\s+", "", s)

Drop the reporter's clause "refuse to collapse when the substitution would make any sub/div have two identical operands": the key string is only a dict key in idea_search.py:222 (`first_form.setdefault(key, e)` stores the real expression `e`, which is what gets scored), so it is never parsed or evaluated and no 0/0 panel can arise from it.

Side effect to be aware of: this makes dedup strictly weaker, so a future idea_search run will score a few more leaf-swap variants and spend a little more budget. Since equivalent=0 in both existing runs, it cannot change anything already reported. If the intent is instead to tighten C7, the evidence to act on is F109's 0.60 and F108's 0.57 utrain-Sharpe spread across pure single-leaf swaps — i.e. C7's own rho 0.96-0.98 premise is the weak link, not the global substitution.
